test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I am just saying that maybe you are letting emotion ______ your better judgment right now.
solution: The correct answer is **"cloud."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Cloud"** means to obscure or confuse someone's judgment or perception. (अस्‍पष्‍ट या दुर्बोध बनाना) • **Example**: *Her personal involvement in the case was beginning to **cloud**__ her judgement.* • In this context, the speaker is suggesting that the person's emotions are making it difficult for them to think clearly or make rational decisions. • The phrase **"letting emotion cloud your judgment" **means to cause someone to be unable to think clearly. (किसी को स्पष्ट रूप से सोचने में असमर्थ बनाना) __ • **Example**: *Your perceptions are **letting me cloud my emotions**__.* • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *I am just saying that maybe you are letting emotion __**cloud**__ your better judgment right now.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Clamp"** means to fasten or secure something tightly. (शिकंजे से दो वस्‍तुओं को बाँधना) • **"Clog" **means to block or obstruct something. (अवरुद्घ हो जाना या कर देना) • **"Finger" **can mean to point at something or accuse someone of wrongdoing, but it doesn't make sense in this context. (अंगुलियों से किसी वस्‍तु को छूना या महसूस करना) 1dd:Tc5a, The correct answer is **"misapply."**
